geeklist.title: Come Get Yer Christmas Gifts
geeklist.description:
Time for another one of my rather large auctions.
Feel free to message me with any questions you have!
1. All games will be listed with a minimum starting bid and/or a Buy It Now (BIN) price.
2. All bids must be in whole dollars.
3. Local pickup is available basically anywhere in Maine.
4. Shipping is from 04280 and will be paid by the winner, and I will ship via Pirate Ship to get the best rates. It's usually around $9-14 for single games, and a bundle of 4 to 6 regular size games is usually around $20. Obviously the West Coast is on the higher end.
5. International bidders are welcome to join, just remember that you will be paying the shipping.
6. All transactions will be done via Venmo, Zelle, or Paypal and I run the items through the BGG marketplace so BGG will get its 3% commission. If you are doing local pickup, I can accept cash.
7. This particular auction will run until sometime in the evening of Saturday, December 6th 2025. I have a set end time for the listings, but I want to discourage sniping.
8. I reserve the right to remove any item from the auction. And I will certainly be adding more games throughout the auction, so check back often!
